title: The site could not keep up with the events.

items.value: The site could not keep up with the events.
Sociafi Media runs serious events. Awards nights, business networking summits and Asia Africa investment forums across Kuala Lumpur, Pattaya, New Delhi and Mumbai.

Someone who heard about an upcoming event had nowhere to check the date, the venue or the pass options. Someone deciding whether to attend could not see photos from the last one, which for an awards and networking event is the most persuasive thing you can show.

And every ticket was sold by hand. A conversation, a payment link, a confirmation, repeated for each attendee. For an events company that manual layer is a hard limit on how many events you can run in a year.

title: Now they buy while they are still excited.

items.value: Now they buy while they are still excited.
Someone can now discover an event, look through photos of the last one, compare pass tiers and pay in a single sitting, with nobody from Sociafi involved.
Announcements reach the list automatically. The event archive keeps working as a sales asset long after the night is over.
Can you add online ticketing to an existing website?
Usually yes. We add the pass tiers, the checkout and the payment gateway, and connect them to the event pages you already have.
Which payment gateway do you use for event tickets?
It depends on where you collect money and in which currency. We set up the gateway that clears fastest for your account and keep the checkout on your own site.
Can attendees get automatic emails about new events?
Yes. Subscribers are added from the site and the announcement goes out on publish, so a new event reaches the list without anyone drafting a mailer.
